name: Net-liquidity impulse regime — faster 4h re-entry into a positive-liquidity uptrend
rationale: MECHANISM: same net-liquidity-impulse thesis as the daily variant (the CHANGE in WALCL-TGA leads crypto beta; giants trade the plumbing on a slow institutional clock while crypto front-runs it), but expressed on a 4h bar so the crypto momentum confirmation reads the tape faster and re-enters intraweek when the slow weekly liquidity gate is open. The weekly net_liquidity_usd value simply persists across the intraday bars (a regime gate), while range_position captures a fresher reclaim than a daily return. DISCONFIRMER: net_liquidity_usd is weekly with available_at = ts+8 days — a 4h bar CANNOT add liquidity timing that a daily bar lacks; the extra intraday churn only adds fees. Kill if the 4h version's OOS net-of-fee Sharpe does not beat the daily variant (hh-macro-01) — the higher turnover must earn its cost or the frequency is decoration on a weekly signal.
catalyst: open net-liquidity regime with a fresh intraday crypto reclaim
